text: Moving from the quiet, clinical threshold of the exterior, I feel a contrast as I enter the vibrant, intellectually charged space of research and development. The shifting environment stirs my curiosity—there’s an invitation here, to contemplate the interaction of humans and machines. Colors and information pulse around me, making me feel more awake and engaged, yet also provoking uncertainty about where I fit in the evolving narrative of technology. The world feels full of promise and questions.
